# smplkit_log_group (Data Source)

Read a smplkit log group by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smplkit_log_group" "http" {
  id = "http"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The log group key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `environments` (Map of String) Per-environment log level overrides.
- `level` (String) Base log level (TRACE…SILENT).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `parent_group` (String) Parent log group id.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-modified timestamp.
